text:
elaine (Eng): Hi folks — got my outpatient bill from Riverside Digestive and the insurer processed it as out-of-network. I checked UnitedCare's directory and Riverside shows as in-network (screenshot attached). Claim #: 990112233. Any advice on next steps?

sam (People Ops): Sorry you're dealing with that. Which Redwood plan are you on? Can you upload the EOB and the directory screenshot here?

elaine (Eng): I'm on Redwood Core PPO (RW-PPO-2025). Uploaded EOB.pdf and directory.png. Provider NPI on the EOB is 0987654321.

benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-PPO-2025 125 UnitedCare. Directory snapshot (2025-04-15): Riverside Digestive 125 In-Network. Appeal guidance: provider disputes & member appeals: https://unitedcare.example/appeals. Phone: 1-800-555-9012.

sam (People Ops): Two common reasons: 1) billing tax ID / TIN mismatch (claims billed under a hospital/group TIN that isn't linked as participating); 2) date of service vs. network change. I'll reach out to our broker Ara at Harbor Benefits to confirm. In the meantime, you can file an online appeal. Would you like a short copy to paste into the portal?

elaine (Eng): Yes please, that'd be great. If I need to call, what do I say to get a reference?

ara (Broker): Hi all 03 I can check the group/tax ID mapping with UnitedCare and follow up. Typical appeal checklist: EOB, appointment confirmation, provider directory screenshot, provider NPI, and if available, a CPT/charge line detail. If you call UnitedCare, ask for a Provider Resolution specialist and request a case ID for the appeal.

sam (People Ops): Paste this into the portal or tell the rep: 

"""
To UnitedCare Provider Resolutions,

Please review Claim #990112233 for services on 2025-04-12 billed by Riverside Digestive (NPI 0987654321). My plan is Redwood Core PPO (Member ID: XXXXXXX). The UnitedCare online directory lists Riverside Digestive as in-network (see attached screenshot). The claim was adjudicated as out-of-network; please reprocess as in-network and correct member liability. Attached: EOB, provider directory screenshot, appointment confirmation.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

elaine (Eng): Thanks. Filing now and will paste that exact wording.

benefits-bot: Appeal submitted: UnitedCare Case ID UCARE-2025-0426-7788. Submitter: elaine (Eng). Link: https://unitedcare.example/cases/UCARE-2025-0426-7788

sam (People Ops): Internal ticket logged HR-BEN-752. Ara 03 can you confirm if there's a TIN mapping issue with Riverside or if UnitedCare needs the provider to re-register?

ara (Broker): Will do. If UnitedCare requests a corrected billing TIN, provider billing will need to resubmit. I'll open a broker escal with UnitedCare and loop in provider billing.

tom (Finance): If you're out of pocket and need short-term cash help, Finance can front the amount as an advance. DM me the EOB and amount.

elaine (Eng): Appreciate the help, team. I'll post updates here once I get the insurer case number or anything else. :thumbsup:
